units.title: Hello & introductions
outcomes: Can greet people, introduce myself and others, and give basic personal information using simple fixed phrases.

units.title: People & family
outcomes: Can talk about my family, say who people are, and describe what I have using simple possessives and numbers.

units.title: Home & things
outcomes: Can describe my home and the things in a room, saying what there is and pointing to objects near and far.

units.title: Daily routines & time
outcomes: Can describe my daily routine, say how often I do things, and tell the time.

units.title: Food & drink
outcomes: Can say what food and drink I like and dislike, and order simple things in a café.

units.title: Places in town
outcomes: Can say where places are, ask for and give simple directions, and talk about what I can and can't do.

units.title: Work & study
outcomes: Can ask and answer wh- questions about jobs and study, and say dates.

units.title: Free time & hobbies
outcomes: Can say what I am doing right now and talk about my hobbies and free-time activities.

units.title: Shopping & money
outcomes: Can ask about prices, buy simple things in a shop, and talk about how much things cost.

units.title: Weather, clothes & seasons
outcomes: Can describe the weather and what people are wearing, and join simple ideas with basic connectors.

units.title: Yesterday
outcomes: Can talk about where I was and how I felt in the past using was/were and simple past time expressions.

units.title: Plans & review
outcomes: Can talk about simple future plans using going to, and use the full range of A1 grammar to communicate about myself and my world.

units.title: My story
outcomes: I can narrate a short sequence of past events in my life and ask and answer simple questions about when things happened.

units.title: Travel & holidays
outcomes: I can describe what was happening at a moment in the past and set the background to a story about a trip.

units.title: Comparing things
outcomes: I can compare two or more people, places or objects and say which is the best or worst.

units.title: Future plans
outcomes: I can talk about my intentions, make predictions, and offer to do things, choosing the right future form.

units.title: Health & body
outcomes: I can describe how I feel, say what is wrong, and give and understand simple health advice.

units.title: Food & restaurants
outcomes: I can talk about quantities of food, order a meal, and say whether there is too much, too little or enough of something.

units.title: Experiences
outcomes: I can talk about life experiences without saying exactly when, and ask others what they have done.

units.title: Getting around
outcomes: I can explain why I do things, describe how actions are done, and ask for and give directions.

units.title: People, then & now
outcomes: I can describe how people and habits were different in the past, and describe someone's appearance and character.

units.title: Rules & possibilities
outcomes: I can talk about rules, general truths, and real future possibilities and their results.

units.title: Entertainment & media
outcomes: I can say what I enjoy and want to do in my free time and connect ideas in the right order.

units.title: Milestone
outcomes: I can handle the everyday A2 tasks of the whole level — narrating, comparing, planning, advising and describing — using the structures practised in this course, and identify what needs further practice.

units.title: Milestones & life stories
outcomes: I can tell the story of my life so far, linking finished events to their effect on my life now.

units.title: Work in progress
outcomes: I can talk about activities that started in the past and are still going on, and say how long they have lasted.

units.title: Storytelling
outcomes: I can tell a story about the past and make clear which events happened before other events.

units.title: Real possibilities
outcomes: I can talk about future plans, predictions and likely results, and choose the right future form.

units.title: Imagine
outcomes: I can talk about imaginary or unlikely situations and their results, and say what I would do.

units.title: Habits, past & present
outcomes: I can compare how things used to be with how they are now, and describe past habits that have changed.

units.title: He said, she said
outcomes: I can report what other people said, and use *say* and *tell* correctly.

units.title: It was made here
outcomes: I can describe processes and facts where the action matters more than who does it.

units.title: Reading between the lines
outcomes: I can say how sure I am about something based on evidence, and check information with question tags.

units.title: People & places
outcomes: I can give extra information about people, things and places in one sentence using relative clauses.

units.title: Patterns & connections
outcomes: I can use common verb patterns correctly and link my ideas naturally with everyday phrasal verbs.

units.title: Milestone
outcomes: I can combine the grammar and vocabulary of B1 to handle a PET-style checkpoint covering everything so far.

units.title: Regrets & what-ifs
outcomes: I can talk about past regrets and imagine how the past could have been different, using the third conditional and *wish / if only*.

units.title: Crossed timelines
outcomes: I can connect a past cause to a present result, and a present fact to a past result, using mixed conditionals.

units.title: Deep narrative
outcomes: I can tell a detailed story, showing how long something had been going on before another past event, and combine actions smoothly.

units.title: It is said that…
outcomes: I can report information impersonally when the source is unknown or unimportant, using the passive in any tense.

units.title: Getting things done
outcomes: I can talk about services and jobs done for me by someone else, using the causative *have / get something done*.

units.title: Hindsight
outcomes: I can criticise, deduce and speculate about past actions using perfect modals.

units.title: Reporting everything
outcomes: I can report statements, questions and commands accurately, and use precise reporting verbs.

units.title: Adding layers
outcomes: I can add extra, non-essential information to a sentence smoothly using relative clauses.

units.title: The future, completed
outcomes: I can talk about actions in progress at a future time and actions finished by a future point.

units.title: Emphasis & flow
outcomes: I can add emphasis and connect ideas smoothly using inversion, cleft sentences and discourse markers.

units.title: Word power
outcomes: I can build new words with prefixes and suffixes, and choose natural word partnerships.

units.title: Milestone
outcomes: I can combine all B2 grammar under exam conditions and handle B2 First (FCE) Use of English task types.

units.title: Nuance & Hedging
outcomes: I can soften claims, signal uncertainty and distance myself from assertions with the precision expected in academic and professional discourse.

units.title: Emphasis Engineered
outcomes: I can front negative and restrictive adverbials and invert subject and auxiliary to add dramatic emphasis in formal writing and speech.

units.title: What Matters Is…
outcomes: I can restructure sentences with cleft constructions and fronting to spotlight the exact element I want the listener to focus on.

units.title: The Unsaid
outcomes: I can leave out or replace repeated words with *so*, *neither*, *one*, *do so* and other pro-forms to keep my speech and writing economical and cohesive.

units.title: Academic Voice
outcomes: I can write in an objective academic register, using nominalization and layered passive constructions to foreground processes and findings rather than the people behind them.

units.title: Formal Moves
outcomes: I can use the subjunctive and diplomatic phrasing to make demands, recommendations and objections sound formal, measured and tactful.

units.title: Compression
outcomes: I can compress two clauses into one using participle and reduced relative clauses, writing more economically and elegantly.

units.title: Weaving Text
outcomes: I can manage extended discourse with a wide range of cohesive devices, signposting the relationships between ideas and holding a long turn together.

units.title: Time Under the Microscope
outcomes: I can exploit fine distinctions of tense and aspect to shade meaning in narrative, reportage and hypothetical accounts.

units.title: Idiom, collocation & register
outcomes: I can deploy idioms, strong collocations and shifts of register, and recognise humour and irony, so as to sound natural and read between the lines.

units.title: The Art of the Argument
outcomes: I can build a persuasive case, concede fairly, rebut counterarguments and use rhetorical moves to prevail in a reasoned debate.

units.title: Milestone
outcomes: I can integrate the full range of C1 grammar, vocabulary and discourse skills across complex spoken and written tasks at CAE level.
